info.title: Follow the Rupee: Backend
info.description:
Pre-Payment Audit Gate + Citizen Rupee Receipt for Mumbai monsoon road repairs (synthetic dataset).

Every number is computed by the pipelines (`audit_engine/run_audit.py`, `scorecard_planner/run_pipeline.py`); endpoints only select and shape. Flags are labelled *Needs Explanation* or *Recoverable under DLP*, and every flag carries `evidence_row_ids`. Amounts are whole rupees (INR). No login.

get.description:
View 4 deterministic lookup: free text -> road receipt.
Tries a road name in the text first ("Andheri subway ke bahar..."), then any locality name/alias/Devanagari.
Fuzzy/vernacular parsing beyond this is the Claude /api/citizen-query layer's job.

parameters.name: q

schema.description: Free text: road name, locality, alias or Devanagari
examples: Andheri subway ke bahar wapas khadda ho gaya, paisa kahan gaya?
